summary: This is a routine 8-K filed by Bain Capital Private Credit relating to a fourth amendment to its existing Senior Secured Revolving Credit Agreement. The amendment increases the total facility amount from $650 million to $750 million and expands the accordion provision from $800 million to $1 billion. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special-situation event. The filing represents a standard credit facility modification for a business development company. No deal terms, premium, board recommendation, or risk-arb angle are present. This is an ordinary financing activity, not a special situation.
